v16_rules._about: Agent decisions 2026-11-04 under user's delegation (beats-youtube-cc --v16-rules). A: an EXACT YouTube CC clip may replace (1) the archival Sudarshan Setu under-construction hold when its narration names a place below (real finished bridge > archival still) and (2) a REPRESENTATIVE still/stock shot whose own narration names the clip's place. Cards, maps, exact shots stay protected; no repeats; the replaced archival still is not reused elsewhere (only map beats S14_b06/b07 also talk about the bridge, and maps are protected) -> dropped. C: `force` beats take any eye-passed clip (no stock animation). `prefer`: eye-picked clip per unit (first beat).
